title: Ford Vickers Wellington
memorial_details: Post with metal plaque on top. Commemoration with names and image of Wellington Bomber.
inscription: Royal Air Force In memory of Sergeant Victor George Bailey, 1585910, Royal Air Force Volunteer Reserve. Wireless Operator, aged 20 yrs. Of Rainham, Essex And Seargent Louis Grover Martin, R/182617, Royal Canadian Air Force, Rear Gunner, aged 22 yrs. of Big River, Saskatchewan, Canada Who died when their Wellington Bomber Crashed in Ford On 9th January, 1944.
narrative: On 9 January 1944, a Wellington bomber crashed at Ford in Buckinghamshire. Sergeant Victor George Bailey (service number 1585910, RAFVR), Wireless Operator, aged 20, from Rainham, Essex, and Sergeant Louis Grover Martin (service number R/182617, RCAF), Rear Gunner, aged 22, from Big River, Saskatchewan, Canada, were both killed. A post and plaque memorial at Ford records the names and roles of both men.
original_title: Victor George Bailey and Louis Grover Martin - Wellington Crash, Ford
